name: Saeki Momo
source:
Momo has been painting since an early age. Momo finds painting very fun, and enjoys it so much that she will often leave in the middle of class to go outside and sketch. Whenever [url=/c98201]Natsumi[/url] or [url=/c98256]Sumire[/url] worry about something, she displays surprising amounts of maturity and offers them advice.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
